topics.label: Introduction and overview of the hallmarks of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: The lecture opens with framing on the learning objectives, context from previous lectures, and an overview of the hallmarks of cancer framework.

topics.label: Deregulated growth and proliferative signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in cell surface receptors and intracellular signaling cascades drive sustained proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation blocks in hematopoietic malignancies and carcinomas
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics illustrate how failure of cells to exit the cell cycle and complete terminal differentiation leads to tumor formation across different tissue types.

topics.label: Resistance to programmed cell death through apoptosis evasion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how cancer cells evade apoptosis by altering the balance of Bcl-2 family proteins and inactivating p53 tumor suppressor signaling.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, telomere regulation, and senescence bypass
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells overcome telomere shortening and p53-mediated senescence barriers to achieve unlimited replicative potential.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolites in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how cancer cells rewire cellular metabolism toward aerobic glycolysis and generate oncometabolites that alter gene expression.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses how expanding tumors overcome oxygen and nutrient diffusion limits by tipping the molecular balance to stimulate new blood vessel growth.

topics.label: Mechanisms, tracking, and genetics of cancer metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the biological steps, clinical tracking, microenvironmental determinants, and genomic characteristics involved in metastatic spread.

topics.label: Conclusion and closing remarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecture concludes with final reflections on the cancer hallmarks literature and housekeeping for upcoming practical sessions.
